## Connect once. Ready whenever you are.
Continue using your DeepSeek Harness instance from a phone, computer, or browser. Return to the same
Harness session from whichever device is with you.
Harness keeps running on your work computer, with the same workspaces, tools, and project setup. DS
Harness Remote is simply another window into that environment.
The DeepSeek Harness desktop edition is supported. Install the latest release:
`ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`
## Features
- Access your local Harness instance remotely from the web, a PC, or a mobile device: DSH first, wit

h Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity support too.
- DeepSeek Harness Desktop is ready to use after insta

llation, with its native interface and no separate desktop conversation UI.
- Create workspaces, con

figure models, and switch conversation models with the same smooth workflow as local use.
- No publi
c listening port or public IP is required on the Harness Host. Connect from anywhere with internet a

ccess over a bidirectional end-to-end encrypted channel.
- Prefer P2P connections, use TURN relay no

des worldwide, and fall back to multiple Server Relays when needed.
- Access workspace files, read-o
nly previews, remote terminals, and authorized local development-service previews through the native

Harness sidebar.
- Remote Tool context injection supports Host and workspace discovery, Harness ses
sion creation and management, history reading, waiting for execution, interruption requests, and aut

horized file transfers. Details.
- Alongside DeepSeek Harness, access native workspaces for Codex, C
ursor, Google Antigravity, Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, Harness Agent, and other tools through ACP int

egrations, with remote file browsing and terminals.
- Clients are available across Android, iOS, Web

, and native DSH.
- Multiple clients can connect to the same Harness Host simultaneously, with RPC c
alls and streams isolated per connection.
## Supported clients
| Client | Form | Status | Notes |
| DSH Desktop plugin | Remote sidebar | Supported | Install `ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`; this computer

can also be the Host |
| Web | Browser page | Supported | Open https://dsh.r2049.cn; reuses the nat

ive Harness interface |
| Android | Native app | Supported | Download the APK from Releases; see the

Android guide |
| DSH Go | A standout app by ccch1mneyyy | Supported | See ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go: an A
ndroid client for DeepSeek Harness. Run it directly on your phone or control DSH on your computer re

motely. |
| iOS | TestFlight beta | Beta | Not publicly released; see issue #20 |
| Browser extensio
n | Chrome | Entry point only | Exchanges an already signed-in Web authorization for a separate devi
ce credential, lists online Hosts and opens the same-origin Remote Web; it does not host a conversat

ion UI |
| dsh-TUI | Terminal-only CLI | Planned | Integration is not part of this release and retur

ns in a later version; the installer never creates a Web service for it automatically |
| Linux | Cl
oud server | Supported | Sign in on the official website to install with one command. |
Several clients can connect to the same Host at once; RPC calls and streams are isolated per connect
ral clients can connect to the same Host at once; RPC calls and streams are isolated per connection.
## Install
### DeepSeek Harness Desktop support

Open **Extensions / Plugin management** in DeepSeek Harness Desktop, choose installation
from npm, a
nd enter this package:
`ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`

Restart Desktop afterward. Its official `dsh` launcher can also install the pinned package
with `dsh
plugin --profile desktop add -w ds-harness-remote@0.6.4`.
On DSH 0.2.2+, npm installations support version checks and updates in Plugin management, with an at
tempt to restore the previous version if hot updating fails. GitHub and local link installations mus
t switch to npm first; see online updates.
### Linux one-command installation
Visit https://dsh.r2049.cn, sign in, and obtain an installation authorization code to install with o
://dsh.r2049.cn, sign in, and obtain an installation authorization code to install with one command.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The Harness Host does not need a public listening port. Connect from anywhere with internet access o
ver ds-harness-remote’s bidirectional end-to-end encrypted channel.
The client switches to the selected Host’s native Harness API, keeping the original workspaces, tool
s, and permission flows on that computer.
You can also edit Harness and plugin settings on the remote host. Available options depend on which
settings Harness and each plugin expose through the official settings API.
## Security
- On LAN and P2P paths, data bypasses the Server except for connection coordination. TURN uses the o

pen-source coturn server; Relay mode forwards traffic over WebSocket.
- Session traffic is end-to-en
d encrypted. The service relays ciphertext without storing session plaintext or device private keys.

- Same-account devices connect without extra confirmation; see device trust and permissions.
- Remo
te Tools injection — optional `remote_*` session tools; enabled by default and configurable in detai

led Remote settings.
- Interactive terminals use the Host-local `terminal.enabled` switch (on by def

ault). They run as the Host user, independently of Agent approvals.
- General tool RPC and remote de

sktop are not exposed.
- The workspace picker lists folders only and returns bounded, read-only dire

ctory metadata.
- Remote file preview cannot write, delete, upload, execute, or open a path in an ex

ternal application.
- Codex Remote / Agent ACP is optional, can be disabled, and follows the same en

crypted Host permission boundary as the rest of Remote.
- Removing a device revokes its credentials,
membership, and active Remote connections.
